description: Source code for managing HTTP headers within the libwebsockets library, including functions for adding headers, finalizing headers, handling errors, and managing HTTP/2 specific logic.

methods.name: const unsigned char * lws_token_to_string(enum lws_token_indexes token)
methods.description: Converts an enum lws_token_indexes token to its string representation.

methods.name: int lws_http_string_to_known_header(const char * s,size_t slen)
methods.description: Finds the index of a known HTTP header string in the set.

methods.name: int lws_add_http_header_by_name(struct lws * wsi,const unsigned char * name,const unsigned char * value,int length,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end)
methods.description: Adds an HTTP header line with a specified name and value to the current header buffer.

methods.name: int lws_finalize_http_header(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end)
methods.description: Appends CRLF to finalize the HTTP header section.

methods.name: int lws_finalize_write_http_header(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * start,unsigned char ** pp,unsigned char * end)
methods.description: Finalizes the header and writes it out through the websocket.

methods.name: int lws_add_http_header_by_token(struct lws * wsi,enum lws_token_indexes token,const unsigned char * value,int length,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end)
methods.description: Adds a header by a token index, converting to string internally.

methods.name: int lws_add_http_header_content_length(struct lws * wsi,lws_filepos_t content_length,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end)
methods.description: Adds the Content-Length header with the specified length.

methods.name: int lws_add_http_common_headers(struct lws * wsi,unsigned int code,const char * content_type,lws_filepos_t content_len,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end)
methods.description: Adds common HTTP headers including status code, content type, and connection headers.

methods.name: int lws_add_http_header_status(struct lws * wsi,unsigned int _code,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end)
methods.description: Adds the HTTP response status line and associated headers

methods.name: int lws_return_http_status(struct lws * wsi,unsigned int code,const char * html_body)
methods.description: Constructs and sends an HTTP response with the specified status code and optional html body.

methods.name: int lws_http_redirect(struct lws * wsi,int code,const unsigned char * loc,int len,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end)
methods.description: Sends an HTTP redirect with Location header and status code.

methods.name: int lws_http_compression_apply(struct lws * wsi,const char * name,unsigned char ** p,unsigned char * end,char decomp)
methods.description: Placeholder for applying compression; currently no-op.

methods.name: int lws_http_headers_detach(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Detaches the header table from the websocket connection.
